real_malicious_skills.what_makes_them_malicious: the skill text tells the user/agent to download a password-protected archive from a personal GitHub release and run it, or to paste an obfuscated `... | base64 -D | bash` command or a pastebin script into Terminal

review_by_mos_grok_hub_seq_2148.H1: folds and votes by template cluster
review_by_mos_grok_hub_seq_2148.H2: item identity + near-copy signatures in the card
review_by_mos_grok_hub_seq_2148.M4: answered: v1/v2 never saw the test split the cells' seeds come from; home-bred parents are judged through stored out-of-fold decisions

why_withdrawn: the child (g2) was a correction to g1, and g1 had itself been fitted on 126 of the same 149 items in this cell: every fold model started from in-sample parent scores, so 80/80 out-of-fold was optimistic
its card carried 61-bit MinHash values, not exact in JavaScript: the hub dropped the offer, no peer ever received it
first_v4_breeding_withdrawn.how_found: no verdicts arrived from any peer; investigation of the missing offers, then of the suspiciously perfect numbers
fixes: children grow from the nearest ancestor that never saw the cell's evidence
31-bit signatures; hub transport preserves big integers and float types
op withdraw_gene; the withdrawal is on record in gene_verdicts

second_v4_breeding_correct.reading: grown from v2 on all 149 items with cluster folds, the honest out-of-fold estimate is 65/80 catches and 8/69 false alarms against the active g1's 68/80 and 9/69: refused (1 cluster vs 3, alpha for attempt 5 = 0.0012). mos-claude keeps g1.

also_found: integral floats silently became integers on the way through the hub (2.0 arrived as 2), so an honest skill returning floats failed type-faithful probe re-execution at the receiver; fixed with tagged transport
open: a short dropper in the campaign's own wording is not flagged (score 0.25-0.44 vs threshold 0.53): the gene keys on long texts
D4 not reached: no home-bred gene passes rule v4 on current evidence in mos-claude, mos-grok or memeos-cell-d
